SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY File No. D. 7053. No. S. B. D. / Date Branch SECTION, Date December 7, 1935.）

Subject Lee Pao Tsoong alias Nyi Tsz Soong, suspected communist aviator.

Made by D. I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by （签名）

Further enquiries elicit the information that
Lee Tsz-sung (李志森), age 26, native of Chun-san (中山),
Kwangtung, who is in all probability identical with the
suspected communist aviator mentioned in this file, has
been registered as a resident at No.157 Tong Pao Shing
(東宝兴路), Chapei, since October 1932. Other members of
his family also residing at this address comprise the
following :-
A mother Lee Wei-shing (李薇馨), age 50.
2 sisters Lee Tsz-sien (李紫仙), age 13.
Lee Yoh-sien (李悅仙), age 11.
2 brothers Lee Tsz-ying (李志英), age 8.
Lee Tsz-yong(李志雄), age 6.
2 friends Tsang Yong-wen(庄荣文), age 22.
Ting Zang-tsen(丁上正), age 23.
2 maid-servants Lee Lee-sien (李麗仙).
Lee Liu-sien (李侶仙).

Lee Tsz-sung left Shanghai and proceeded to
Nanking on December 6 and is expected to pass through Shanghai
enroute to Loyang, Honan, on December 8.

Enquiries assisted

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT

(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE)
File No. REG. S.
No. S. B. D. 7008
Branch ... Station ...
Date November 4, 1935.

Subject Nyi Tsz Soong, suspected communist aviator.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by (签名)

With reference to the D.C. Special Branch memo
of October 25, 1935, on the subject of a suspected communist
aviator named Nyi Tsz Soong, exhaustive enquiries have failed
to establish the identity of this individual. The address
No.517 Tong Pau Shing Road, North Szechuen Road, has found
to be non-existent as the highest number in that thoroughfare
reads 339.

The local Chinese Authorities upon being
confidentially approached are also unable to furnish any
information regarding the identity of this individual and
in the absence of the Chinese characters for his name
it is almost impossible to pursue the enquiry further.

Kuh Pao hwa
D. I.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)
